import json, subprocess, sys
PROG='/app/submission/scheduler.py'
ERR=b'{"error":"invalid input"}\n'
def run(raw):
    if isinstance(raw,str): raw=raw.encode()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',PROG],input=raw,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
res=[]
def inv(raw,label):
    rc,out,err=run(raw); res.append((rc==2 and out==ERR and err==b'', label, rc, out[:80], err[:80]))
def val(raw,label):
    rc,out,err=run(raw); ok = rc==0 and err==b'' and out.endswith(b'\n') and b'\n' not in out[:-1]
    res.append((ok,label,rc,out[:80],err[:80]))
    return json.loads(out) if ok else None

# duplicate id via unicode escape
inv('{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":2,"borders":[0,2],"start_bank":0,"packets":[{"id":"\\u0061","lane":0,"rank":0},{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1}]}','dup id escape')
# duplicate key via escape
inv('{"mode":"burst","\\u0062anks":1,"banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":2,"borders":[0,2],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}','dup key escape')
# key order shuffled + pretty printed
req=json.load(open('/app/examples/stream.json'))
shuf=json.dumps(req,indent=3,sort_keys=True)
o=val(shuf,'shuffled/pretty stream')
exp=json.load(open('/app/examples/stream.expected.json'))
res.append((o==exp,'shuffled equals expected',0,b'',b''))
req2=json.load(open('/app/examples/burst.json'))
o2=val(json.dumps(req2,indent=4,sort_keys=True),'shuffled/pretty burst')
exp2=json.load(open('/app/examples/burst.expected.json'))
res.append((o2==exp2,'burst shuffled equals expected',0,b'',b''))
# CRLF whitespace
val('{\r\n"mode":"burst",\r\n"banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":2,"borders":[0,2],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]\r\n}\r\n','crlf')
# tabs / all whitespace kinds
val('\t\n\r {"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":2,"borders":[0,2],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]} \t\n','ws around')
# trailing comma
inv('{"mode":"burst",}','trailing comma')
# comments
inv('{"mode":"burst"} // hi','comment')
# -0 rank
val('{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":2,"borders":[0,2],"start_bank":0,"packets":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":-0}]}','rank -0')
# -0 limit
inv('{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":-0,"borders":[0,2],"start_bank":0,"packets":[]}','limit -0')
# big ints ok in t
val('{"mode":"stream","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":2,"borders":[0,2],"capacity":1,"epoch":0,"steps":[{"t":0,"serve":true,"arrivals":[{"id":"a","lane":0,"rank":1}]},{"t":9007199254740991,"serve":true,"arrivals":[]}]}','max t wait')
# 2^53 in t -> invalid
inv('{"mode":"stream","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":2,"borders":[0,2],"capacity":1,"epoch":0,"steps":[{"t":9007199254740992,"serve":true,"arrivals":[]}]}','t 2^53')
# nested null in arrivals
inv('{"mode":"stream","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":2,"borders":[0,2],"capacity":1,"epoch":0,"steps":[{"t":0,"serve":true,"arrivals":[null]}]}','null arrival')
# empty object step
inv('{"mode":"stream","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":2,"borders":[0,2],"capacity":1,"epoch":0,"steps":[{}]}','empty step')
# unicode in id (allowed chars only)
val('{"mode":"burst","banks":2,"lanes":1,"limit":5,"borders":[0,5],"start_bank":0,"packets":[{"id":"A_z-9","lane":0,"rank":4}]}','id charset')
# id with 32 chars
val('{"mode":"burst","banks":1,"lanes":1,"limit":5,"borders":[0,5],"start_bank":0,"packets":[{"id":"'+'a'*32+'","lane":0,"rank":4}]}','id 32')
# stdin closed
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',PROG],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
res.append((p.returncode==2 and p.stdout==ERR,'devnull stdin',p.returncode,p.stdout[:60],p.stderr[:60]))
# invalid json truncated
inv('{"mode":"burst","banks":1','truncated')
# array of packets at top
inv('[{"mode":"burst"}]','array top')
fails=[r for r in res if not r[0]]
for ok,label,rc,out,err in res:
    if not ok: print('FAIL',label,rc,out,err)
print('odd total',len(res),'failed',len(fails))
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
PYEOF
